description: Search quantum computing research papers from arXiv. Use when the user asks about recent research, specific papers, or academic topics in quantum computing. NOT for jobs (use searchJobs) or researcher profiles (use searchCollaborators). Supports natural language queries decomposed via AI into structured filters (topic, tag, author, affiliation, domain). Date range defaults to last 7 days; max lookback 12 months. Returns newest first, max 50 results. Use getPaperDetails for full abstract and analysis of a specific paper. Examples: "trapped ion papers from Google", "QEC review papers this month", "quantum error correction".

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Default: today

query.description: Natural language query to filter papers by topic, author, affiliation, or tag. Uses an AI model to decompose into structured filters. Examples: "quantum error correction", "trapped ion papers from Google", "review papers on QEC"

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Default: 7 days ago

name: searchPapers
title: Search Quantum Papers
